messages:
maria: Quick sync from the Rate Limiter postmortem. We need clear owners + deadlines for customer-facing items: (A) status page wording, (B) 72h public summary, (C) policy for sharing detailed RCAs (redaction + consent). Also call out recurring routing patterns in the 72h doc. Volunteer?

ben: I can take (A) status page wording. I’ll do a single-line TL;DR + one bullet for impact + one for next steps. Draft by 2026-03-27 EOD and will drop here for reviews.

liz: I’ll co-own (B) the 72h summary with Jordan; I’ll focus on tone and legal redaction. Plan: impact matrix, mitigation timeline, recurrence note. Target 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC.

sam: I’ll own (C) RCA sharing policy. Tasks: define recipient tiers (public summary / impacted customers / internal), redaction rules (no customer IDs/screenshots), and a consent/opt-in flow. Deliver by 2026-03-25 COB.

jordan: I’ll run the recurring-incident blurb and attach a short analysis. I already see 2 similar routing-policy regressions in last 90 days; recommend a routing-audit and short rollout checklist. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks. I added these to the postmortem action tracker. Please make deliverables explicit and include a single POC email. Initial tracker snippet I added to the doc: ```- status page blurb  owner: ben  due: 2026-03-27 EOD
- 72h public summary  owners: liz, jordan  due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC
- RCA sharing policy + consent flow  owner: sam  due: 2026-03-25 COB
- remediation plan update  owner: eng-sre  due: 2026-04-02```

ben: Draft status text posted: "We experienced a brief period of request throttling (429 responses) due to an incorrect quota routing rule. Impact: small subset of requests. Mitigation: traffic reroute and hotfix. Next steps: permanent routing guard and improved monitoring. POC: incidents@redwood.com" Thoughts?

liz: Edit suggestions: drop internal timing, use "brief throttling" wording, add link to the live status page, and add a short "what we’re doing to prevent recurrence" section. Legal: no customer names or screenshots in public copy.

sam: Legal follow-up: for detailed RCAs, require explicit customer consent before sharing unredacted identifiers. I’ll draft a minimal consent checkbox + email flow and a short request form. Default: public summary redacted.

jordan: Uploaded the recurrence analysis and added suggested public phrasing: one sentence referencing a pattern and the planned audit. Also attached a remediation tracker link.

sre-bot: Postmortem recorded: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated with the items above.

maria: Perfect. I’ll set calendar reminders and nudge owners 24h before due dates. If anyone needs to swap ownership, post here. :spiral_calendar:
